songs.title: Rowdy Baby
songs.lyrics_full:
Hey en goli sodaave, en kari kozhambae!
Un kutty puppy naan, take me, take me!
Hey rowdy baby... unnale mood aachu!
One plus one two mama, you plus me free mama!
songs.notes: Playful Chennai street romance & energetic dance celebration between a charismatic local hero and his bold partner.

songs.title: Dernière Danse
songs.lyrics_full:
Oh ma douce souffrance... pourquoi s'acharner ?
Je ne suis qu'un être sans importance...
Je remue le ciel, le jour, la nuit...
Je danse avec le vent, la pluie...
songs.notes: Poetic struggle against sorrow in twilight Paris—turning pain and solitude into a defiant dance with the wind and rain.

songs.title: Believer
songs.lyrics_full:
First things first, I'ma say all the words inside my head...
I'm fired up and tired of the way that things have been...
PAIN! You made me a, you made me a BELIEVER!
Let the bullets fly, let them rain...
songs.notes: Rising above self-doubt and hardship on a sunset rooftop, transforming every setback into unbreakable creative fire.

songs.title: Sing About Me
songs.lyrics_full:
When the lights shut off and it's my turn to settle down...
My main concern: promise that you will sing about me...
Walking down this midnight avenue, streetlamps glowing...
Promise that you will sing about me...
songs.notes: Midnight reflection along quiet city avenues—honoring memory, legacy, and stories that outlive the night.
